trail.text: Flagged services show route-service strain — now digging to confirm the source.
Route-service is showing massive memory and latency spikes while neighbors look quiet — now checking callers and data stores for spread.
Multiple downstream services show latency fallout — now pinning down timing to separate cause from victims.

causes.reasoning: Massive memory pressure (14 to 145k failures, usage 190M to 436M) with CPU-system 0.65 to 20.6 and p99 latency 0.024 to 0.636 starting at flag shows resource exhaustion originating here.
p99 latency jumped 0.245 to 1.065 with no corresponding CPU/memory rise, consistent with blocking on degraded route-service as downstream victim.
Same p99 latency jump 0.24 to 1.05 with flat container resources, indicating victim waiting on route-service.
Node disk writes 3.5 to 117 and written bytes 41k to 651k coincide with route-service memory blowup, likely host-level paging/swapping effect.
p99 latency 0.04 to 0.28 with flat resources suggests secondary victim of route/travel degradation, not origin.
